verdict.rationale: telli documents custom tools connecting to external APIs (telli-docs-20) and even an MCP server (telli-docs-22, telli-probe-3), but that MCP server lets external AI tools like Claude/ChatGPT talk to telli's Charlie assistant — it is telli acting as an MCP server, not the voice agent consuming external MCP servers as a tool source mid-call. There is no evidence the voice agent itself can plug in MCP servers to gain toolsets during a call.
